sql:
SELECT
    coalesce(pc.ProductCategoryName, 'Unknown') AS product_category,
    round(sumIf(s.sales_amount, s.is_promoted = 1), 2) AS promoted_revenue,
    round(sumIf(s.sales_amount, s.is_promoted = 0), 2) AS full_price_revenue,
    round(sumIf(s.sales_amount, s.is_promoted = 1) - sumIf(s.sales_amount, s.is_promoted = 0), 2) AS incremental_revenue_vs_full_price,
    round(
        divide(
            sumIf(s.sales_amount, s.is_promoted = 1) - sumIf(s.sales_amount, s.is_promoted = 0),
            nullIf(sumIf(s.sales_amount, s.is_promoted = 0), 0)
        ) * 100,
        2
    ) AS incremental_revenue_pct_vs_full_price
FROM
(
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        SalesAmount AS sales_amount,
        if(DiscountAmount > 0 OR DiscountQuantity > 0, 1, 0) AS is_promoted
    FROM retail.FactSales

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        SalesAmount AS sales_amount,
        if(DiscountAmount > 0 OR DiscountQuantity > 0, 1, 0) AS is_promoted
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
) AS s
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct p
    ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps
    ON toInt32OrNull(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc
    ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY coalesce(pc.ProductCategoryName, 'Unknown')
ORDER BY incremental_revenue_vs_full_price DESC
